description: PROBLEM: the deployed authorship-audit PreToolUse hook (consumer workspaces, .claude/hooks/principal-identity) blocks commits of gauntlet verdict artifacts whose PROSE discusses ownership semantics. EVIDENCE: origindex arc origindex-lf5, 2026-06-12 — ARGUS verdict line 'owner = token_hash (this design) vs owner = github identity' (a report-ownership DATA-MODEL comparison in an NP ratification item) tripped the gate; the file contains ZERO author-like fields (verified by grep for ^(author|owner|creator|maintainer|by|copyright)[:=]). The originating seat correctly refused --no-verify AND refused to reword the durable verdict; the user-tier overseer adjudicated the false positive and committed at its own (un-hooked) seat — workaround, not a fix (commit 8555904 on origindex-lf5/build). IMPACT: this class will hit ANY security verdict/design discussing ownership/owner fields — i.e., precisely the artifacts most worth committing verbatim; teams either stall or route around the gate. LOCATION: the hook regex/scope as deployed to consumer workspaces. The fix (sharpening scope vs allow-listing artifact paths vs context-aware field detection) is the substrate team's call against current hook source.
title: Authorship PreToolUse gate false-positives on security/design prose discussing ownership
